title: Checkout Form Readiness Fix

sections.name: Checkout
items: Brava now waits for delayed cart and checkout controls instead of treating them as missing profile details.
Multi-step checkout navigation now continues through cart, shipping, payment, and review pages.
State, region, and country fields are now filled from the assigned profile.

sections.name: CAPTCHA
items: Checkout resumes from the exact paused step after a CAPTCHA is solved.
Add to Cart and Place Order controls are never clicked twice during retries.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
